Use unchanged verify-audition.py with explicit --source, --run-id and --run-attempt 1; write new proof only.

Apply the unchanged reviewed bind_validator_upload() to the exact Upload curated preset auditions step. Require matching original successful upload artifact name, ID and byte count, strict job time interval and recorded two-second step-clock tolerance.
Freeze compact proofs, fresh metadata, upload binding, original capture excerpt/log and audition metadata under new ci/source-9c0d2ba/audition/. Keep large ZIP/WAV payloads only in /dev/shm.
remaining_inputs: Actual source-9c0d audition artifact, fresh API metadata and completed native producer job log; parent will wake this agent once available.
limitations: Preparation only: no download, verifier execution, synthetic test, product execution, acoustic assessment, native CI acceptance or publication has occurred.
